main_text.p: شر ومشقة وبادية Mundum non interiturum, Paradi-sum autem esse ea quae contingant hominibus, bona, & delectationem, & sanitatem, Ignem verò ea quae con-tingunt hominibus mala, & molestiam & miseriam: his primò positis, nihil mirum si ulterius progressi

استحلوا الخمر والزنا وسایر المحرمات وادعوا بترك الفرائض والصلوة Licitum pronunciaverint vino & scortationi indulgere, & reliqua quae lege vetita sunt perpetrare, & censuerint omittenda esse quae lege mandata sunt, & orationem.

Porro AlShii (scil. Alis sectatores) illi sunt, &c. Eodem modo nec verbis a ultimum differentibus, quinam sint AlShii nos docent AlShareftanius, هم الزیدیہ شایعوا علیا علی الخصوص وقالوا بخلافتہ وامامتہ دعا ووصایۃ اما جلیا اوخفیا واعتقدوا ان الامامۃ لا تخرج من اولاده وان خرج فیظلم یکون Illi peculiariter sunt qui se * Ali addixerunt, illum & Chalifam & Antistitem [declaratum] afferentes, testimonio & mandato, sive manifesto, sive occulto, & profitentes Antistitis munus aliis quam ejus posteriis deferri non debere, quod si deferatur, fieri hoc ex parte aliorum, injuriâ, aut ex † ipsius parte pra meta. Dicunt enim لیست الامامۃ قضیۃ مصلحیۃ تناط باختیار العامۃ وینتصب الامام بنصبهم فلهذا قضیۃ اصولیۃ هو رکن لا یجوز للرسول اغفالہ واهمالہ ولا تفویضہ الی العامۃ وارسالہ
* Alias enim nomen generaliter significat انبـاع الرجـل واصحاره Kanus.
† scil. qui illud in se non suscipit ex Alis appellevis.

page.notes: <note side="right">lin. 18.</note> <note side="right">* Alias enim nomen generaliter significat انباع الرجل واصحابه Kanus.</note> <note side="right">† scil. qui illud in se non suscipit ex Alis appelevis.</note> Arabic passages are transcribed as far as legible; the Arabic in the upper and lower lines and the marginal Arabic gloss are uncertain and may contain errors. Latin words in the scan are partly blurred (e.g. "Chalifam", "Antistitem", "sectatores"); the note text "appelevis" and the Arabic in the first note are doubtful. The Arabic word "ختار" and the word "Alias" in the note are not fully certain. A faint mark in the right margin near line 18 is a reference. Several Arabic words in paragraphs 1–3 are marked by low confidence; no [?] was placed on each for readability, but reader should verify against the original.
